purpose: First complete-schedule convergence pilot for the clean dual-modal F0 baseline. This is not yet a formal R01-R04 result.

schedule.note: This is a true complete 12k schedule. stop_at_step equals scheduler_total_steps for the budget pilot.

validation.note: Validation uses VAL2 only. stride=256 is frozen for model/budget selection to keep repeated validation affordable; historical TEST6 is not touched during training.

decision_rule.primary: Inspect VAL2 NB mIoU_fg5 trajectory through the complete 12k schedule.
decision_rule.accept_12k: Use 12k as the formal complete schedule if the best validation region is stable/plateaued by the end and no sustained late improvement indicates under-training.
decision_rule.extend: If validation is still materially improving near 12k, run a NEW complete longer-schedule pilot from initialization; do not reinterpret the first 12k steps of a longer schedule as the 12k result.
